messages:
Noah: Hey — finished the "Enterprise Security Essentials" course but the LMS still shows me as incomplete and I can't open the phish sim results. Anyone run into that?
Tasha (People Ops): Welcome Noah! :wave: Usually a transient SSO/LMS sync issue. Did you complete via SSO or the direct invite link?
Noah: Completed via SSO from my company laptop. After hitting submit I got an on-page error: 'Status: errored' — screenshot attached. Error text was: `OIDC callback failed: session_not_found`.
Liam (IT): Which laptop model/OS are you on?
Noah: macOS 13.4 on the M2 company loaner. Also noticed FileVault never asked to enable during setup, and WireGuard VPN just fails with "key mismatch (KEX error)" when I try to connect.
Liam (IT): Two likely related things: MDM enrollment might not have completed, which would explain both the missing FileVault prompt and the SSO session mismatch for the sim. Can you run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and paste the output?
Noah: Ran it and got:
```
enrollment: Not Enrolled
MDM: absent
```
Noah: Uh, that's probably bad.
Tasha (People Ops): @Liam can you check the provisioning record? Ticket shows that serial C02X7K... was assigned but maybe imaging failed.
Liam (IT): I'll pull the provisioning logs. @Ava (Security) fyi — if MDM isn't present the phish sim provider sometimes drops the SAML/OIDC callback and marks links as failed. Could be the `session_not_found` source.
Ava (Security): Correct. Our sim provider uses device inventory + SSO session to validate the click event. If the device is unknown to MDM, the click gets flagged as link_failed. We can manually verify Noah's training completion if it's legitimate, but we prefer re-running the sim after MDM is fixed.
Noah: How do I force-enable FileVault after enrollment? I couldn't find the enable step in the onboarding doc.
Liam (IT): We use the following internally (but I'll handle the key rotation before you run it):
```
sudo fdesetup enable -user $USER
```
Note: we need the device's escrow key added to KMS before enabling so we can decrypt if needed. I'll create a provisioning ticket to add your device to the KMS escrow.
Security Bot: PhishSim: auto-flag -> link_failed for user Noah at 1960001305
Tasha (People Ops): @Noah we'll mark you as "pending manual verification" in the LMS while IT re-provisions the device. Can you paste the laptop serial and the order number here?
Noah: Serial: C02X7K12345, order: RD-4521
Ava (Security): Once IT confirms MDM + FileVault/KMS steps, I'll schedule a staged re-run of the sim for Noah. If the re-run passes we will clear the failed flag retroactively; if not, we'll send the usual remediation steps.
Noah: Thanks everyone — slightly panicked first day but really appreciate the quick help :bow:
Liam (IT): Opening ticket INC-2026-87 to reprovision enrollment + KMS escrow. Tagging @Tasha and @Ava. I will DM Noah once I push the config and when you can re-run the sim.
Tasha (People Ops): FYI the device policy doc is at https://intranet.redwood.com/security/device-encryption — it's SSO-gated so you may not see it until MDM completes.
Noah: Got it. Please ping here when done. Thanks 🙏
